Class Book

java.lang.Object
lms.domain.Book
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoanableItem
public class Book extends Object implements LoanableItem
Represents a book in the Library Management System.

Contains metadata and inventory information including title, author, ISBN, publisher, category, language, copies, and shelf location.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Majd Awwad
